parameters.name: CategoryId
parameters.description: The business catalog ID. Typically set to L1. The query recursively includes mounted tables from all descendant directories.

parameters.name: DbId
parameters.description: The database ID. This parameter is optional and used to filter results by database.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100. Maximum value: 500.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The tenant ID.
> Move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console to view the tenant ID. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
